_README: Real SFDA-sourced medication codes for the demo cohort's drugs, taken from the NPHIES terminology server (the same terminology the claims stack validates against). NOT synthesised: every code below is quoted from the published CodeSystem, with the source URL, version and a digest of the downloaded file recorded so the extraction can be re-derived and checked.
_note_on_completeness: The published resource is a FRAGMENT (1000 concepts) of the SFDA product set, so some drugs the demo needs are absent from it rather than absent from SFDA. They are listed under not_available_from_this_source so the gap is recorded rather than papered over. Do not invent codes for them; obtain them from the SFDA drug list or the full terminology release and add them here with their own provenance.

source.name: NPHIES Scientific Codes (CodeSystem)
source.downloaded_file_note: sha256 prefix of the full CodeSystem JSON as downloaded; re-download and compare before trusting this extract

code_format: <sfda_product_code>-<strength>-<dosage_form_code>, display is <SCIENTIFIC NAME>-<strength><form>. The strength and form segments follow the SFDA product code, so a code identifies a specific product, not a molecule.

codes.note: single-ingredient naproxen 500mg tablet -- matches the drug named in nscre_contraindications.json
single-ingredient meloxicam 15mg -- matches the drug named in nscre_contraindications.json
single-ingredient diclofenac sodium 50mg -- matches the drug named in nscre_contraindications.json

not_available_from_this_source.why_it_matters: nscre_contraindications.json pairs warfarin with four NSAIDs. Without a warfarin code the interaction rule cannot be satisfied by sourced data at all.
not_available_from_this_source.status: absent from the published 1000-concept fragment; not proven absent from SFDA

not_available_from_this_source.why_it_matters: nscre_renal_dose_limits.json applies a renal threshold to metformin. The fragment carries only metformin COMBINATION products (with alogliptin, sitagliptin, dapagliflozin), which are not the same medication.
not_available_from_this_source.status: single-ingredient metformin absent from the fragment; combinations present and deliberately not substituted

not_available_from_this_source.why_it_matters: named in nscre_contraindications.json as a warfarin interaction partner.
not_available_from_this_source.status: the fragment carries ibuprofen 5% gel and 20mg/ml suspension, not a 400mg tablet; a gel is not the systemic NSAID the rule concerns, so none was substituted

how_to_use: Join on scientific name plus strength: a demo medication whose name and strength match a code above may carry that code and be tagged code_system='sfda'. Anything not listed here must be left uncoded -- an uncoded medication makes the NSCRE necessity/dose checks defer honestly, which is the correct behaviour, rather than firing on a code nobody issued.
